sections.title: SECTION 1: SELECT THE CORRECT ANSWER. (5 POINTS)

questions.text: Lily _________ with her friend Timmy after they fought.
questions.explanation: make up = to become friends again after an argument (仲直りする)

questions.text: I just came by to see how you were _________ with your new job.
questions.explanation: make out = manage, get along (うまくやっていく・進捗する)

questions.text: We need to _________ lost time.
questions.explanation: make up for = to compensate for something (埋め合わせる・取り戻す)

questions.text: I'm not sure what to _________ this strange new building.
questions.explanation: make of = to think (of something), as an opinion (〜をどう解釈するか・どう思うか)

questions.text: I heard the thief _________ with all of the Queen's jewels.
questions.explanation: make off (with) = to steal and leave quickly (持ち逃げする)

questions.text: Do you ever _________ an excuse for being late?
questions.explanation: PDF Ex.1: make up = to invent a story / excuse (言い訳や作り話をでっちあげる)

questions.text: Can you always _________ what your English teacher is saying?
questions.explanation: PDF Ex.2: make out = to understand / manage to hear or see (理解する・聞き取る)

questions.text: Has anyone ever _________ your umbrella?
questions.explanation: PDF Ex.3: make off with = to steal (〜を盗む・持ち去る)

questions.text: Did you ever do something bad to someone? What did you do to _________ it?
questions.explanation: PDF Ex.4: make up for = to compensate for something (〜の埋め合わせをする)

questions.text: What do you _________ Fraser's magic?
questions.explanation: PDF Ex.5: make of = to think of something, as an opinion (〜についてどう思うか)

questions.text: James _________ with the cookies. Catch him!
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-D (p.14) Ex.3-1: make off (with) = 持ち逃げする・急いで立ち去る

questions.text: Why are you home late? Don't _________ stories.
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-D (p.14) Ex.3-2: make up = to invent something (作り話をする)

questions.text: How do you plan to _________ your mistakes?
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-D (p.14) Ex.3-3: make up for = to compensate for (ミスを償う・埋め合わせる)

questions.text: I'm sorry, but I can't hear you well. I can hardly _________ what you're saying.
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-D (p.14) Ex.3-4: make out = to manage to see/hear, to understand (聞き取る・理解する)

questions.text: What do you _________ Jim? I think he's funny.
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-D (p.14) Ex.3-5: make of = to think of (opinion) (〜をどう思うか)

questions.text: Which phrasal verb means 'to invent a story or to become friends again after an argument'?
questions.explanation: PDF Definition: make up = A) to invent a story, B) to become friends again after an argument

questions.text: Which phrasal verb means 'to leave somewhere quickly'?
questions.explanation: PDF Definition: make off = to leave somewhere quickly

questions.text: Which phrasal verb means 'to manage to see something or to understand'?
questions.explanation: PDF Definition: make out = A) to manage to see (something), B) to understand

questions.text: After drawing up a few storyboards, I could finally _________ what she had planned.
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-D (p.15) Reading: make out = 理解する・把握する

questions.text: At first, I didn't know what to _________ her ideas.
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 1-D (p.15) Reading: know what to make of ~ = 〜をどう受け止めるべきか分かる
